meta.title: About Us - Sun* Inc. Careers | Digital Creative Studio
meta.description: We are a group of people passionate about creating breakthrough, positive value for society as a whole.

hero.desc:
Imagine a world where everyone is free to create amazing value with the power to change lives. We pursue our own passions while looking toward the future together. We don't just exist - we live to make dreams a reality.
Standing at the intersection of technology, business, and education, we will bring positive change to society as a whole.

meaning.title: Sun Asterisk: Name & Meaning
meaning.desc: Sun Asterisk holds the dream and goal of creating as much good for society as possible, brought to life by a collective of sun warriors.
meaning.sunExplain: The word "Sun" in our company name means "the sun" - the very foundation that sustains all life on Earth. We aim to become the strongest platform, using our light to illuminate and nurture the "seeds" of innovators as well as pioneering, transformative services. By becoming a platform that helps build "Awesome" value, Sun* awakens the creative passion each of us was born with, creating "an equal world where everyone has the chance to bring 'Awesome' value."
meaning.asteriskExplain: * - "Asterisk" is the symbol for multiplication in many programming languages. Crossing the barriers between startups and large enterprises, we bring together and build the most suitable team to create "Awesome" value, driving positive change for society through digital transformation (DX).

vision.title:
Vision
& Mission
vision.visionDesc: A free world where everyone is passionate about creating Awesome value.
vision.missionDesc: Together with people who are ready to embrace every challenge, we build a better society through groundbreaking products and business activities.

core.title: Core Values
core.aimHigh: Having defined Sun*'s vision as "creating a world where everyone is free to create amazing value," we're ready to embrace a journey full of challenges and obstacles. The key to overcoming these challenges is the ability to set challenging goals every day, continuously pushing ourselves beyond our comfort zone to conquer things we once thought impossible.
core.beAgile: We believe that change is the very nature of how the universe moves, the foundation of evolution, and an opportunity to nurture the creativity within each of us. Flexibility to change and transform is arguably our most important weapon - not just to survive, but to keep growing sustainably. Let's master change together with flexibility, creativity, and the mindset of pioneers.
core.wasshoi: "Wasshoi" - the traditional chant heard at Japan's classic festivals - is the sound that best captures Sun*'s spirit of unity. That spirit of unity only truly comes alive when we're teammates who share the same direction, always trusting and supporting one another through every challenge. That bond includes every Sun* member and all of Sun*'s partners, regardless of role, region, or nationality. By shouting "Wasshoi" loud and proud, we find the courage to strive together, stumble together, stand back up together, and move steadily forward together.

ceo.quote:
"As a Digital Creative Studio, Sun*'s goal is to create a world where people can be passionate about creating value.

Living in Japan, there were times I felt truly awful. I know there are people who feel suffocated as each new day begins. Being able to live joyfully is the most wonderful thing of all. And isn't being immersed in creating new value happiness within reach?

If you want to challenge yourself with something new, but don't know where to start and are still hesitant, come to Sun* - together, let's create so many Awesome things for society."

meta.title: Work Environment - Sun* Inc. Careers | Digital Creative Studio
meta.description: Discover Sun* Vietnam's people-centered, dynamic work environment and outstanding benefits policies.

intro.title:
Work
Environment
intro.desc: In striving to achieve Sun*'s mission, creating an environment where every member can bring out their own strengths is paramount. That's why the first thing I ask all of Sun*'s leaders to pay special attention to when setting their goals is motivation, psychological safety, and the growth of their people.

challenge.title: #ActiveChallenge: Proactively creating continuous challenges for yourself
challenge.p1: Sun* is an environment that always champions innovative, creative ideas. With a team of "servant leaders" ready to unlock members' potential and motivation, Sun* always stands alongside talented people pursuing their own passions.
challenge.p2: To turn those passions into achievements, every Sunner proactively creates interesting, challenging work for themselves through effort and a deep understanding of the organization - rather than waiting to be told what to do and how to do it.

learn.title: #ActiveLearn: Learning within an organization with all the right pieces in place - learning environment, learning opportunities, and learning capability.
learn.intro: With a philosophy centered on people's growth, Sun* proactively builds a comprehensive, highly personalized learning organization, sparking members' interest and motivation to learn:
learn.item1: Learning environment: Sunners are given an optimal space with a learning-experience platform, an extensive resource library, a standard competency framework, a continuously upgraded training plan, and a relentless Coaching & Sharing culture.
learn.item2: Learning opportunities: Alongside outstanding colleagues, Sunners get a "tailored" learning plan with diverse online and offline courses, reputable learning sponsorship packages, and challenging opportunities to put theory into practice in their own work.
learn.item3: Learning capability: Sunners are equipped with a smart learning method through the IDP - Individual Development Plan tool - along with the 70-20-10 model (learning from real work, learning from others, learning from books and theory), making learning goal-oriented and tailored to each individual.

joy.title: #ActiveJoy: Living in a culture that values humanity and happiness for everyone
joy.p1: Each member's thoughts and feelings are the top priority in any decision Sun* makes. Sunners are nurtured and developed to build on their strengths, gaining peace of mind through genuine care - not just for themselves, but for their families too.
joy.p2: Rooted in that sincerity, every connection-building and culture-building activity is aimed at one shared goal: creating happiness, joy, and a sense of belonging for Sunners. No matter the role, every member is proud to be a Sunner!
